Please note: In order to reduce expenses, the facility located in the Netherlands will no longer be available in 2027, but we will still provide you with excellent service in our other existing locations.

The facility in Germany will be decommissioned by 2026, for the same reasons as the facility in the Netherlands.

After decommissioning, there will only be one POP in Europe, in the UK, but this will not affect our services in Asia.
